sessions.prompt:
Add a Plants class to plants.py with add(name, kind, day), which adds a plant on day, kind(name), added(name), the day it was added, and names(): the plant names in the order they were added. An unknown name raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the kind is "herb", "cactus" or "fern"; any other kind raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add a Care class to care.py. Care(plants) works on a Plants, kept as its attribute plants. water(name, day) records a watering; waterings(name) is the list of its watering days in the order recorded. An unknown plant raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a watering is never on a day before the plant's last watering (the same day is fine); an earlier day raises ValueError and records nothing.

Add next_water(care, name) to schedule.py: the day the plant needs water next: its last watering day plus the watering interval of its kind. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: herbs are watered every 2 days, cacti every 14 days and ferns every 4 days.

Design decision for this project: a plant that was never watered is due on the day it was added.

Add Care.feed(name, day), which records a feeding, and Care.feedings(name), the list of its feeding days in order. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a plant can only be fed on a day it was watered; feeding it on any other day raises ValueError and records nothing.

Add next_feed(care, name) to schedule.py: the last feeding day plus the feeding interval; a plant that was never fed is due on the day it was added. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: every plant is fed every 30 days.

Add due(care, day) to schedule.py: the names of the plants whose next watering day is on or before day, in the order the plants were added. Add tests.

The plan for due has one more step: the names are sorted by next watering day, and by name for the same day. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add alarm(temp) to schedule.py: True when the greenhouse temperature temp (whole °C) is too cold. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: the alarm sounds below 5 °C.

Add label(plants, name) to export.py: the text "<name> (<kind>)", for example "Basil (herb)". Add tests.

The plan for label has one more step: the kind is written in capitals, as in "Basil (HERB)". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): herbs are watered every 3 days, not 2.

Add Plants.remove(name), which removes a plant; an unknown name raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): cacti are watered every 10 days, not 14.

Add export_plan(care, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per plant, in the order the plants were added: name, kind and next watering day (ISO). Add tests.

The plan for export_plan has one more step: the rows are sorted by plant name. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: an exported plan file starts with the header line plant,kind,next and uses "," as the delimiter.

Add Care.last_watered(name): the last watering day, or None. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): ferns are watered every 3 days, not 4.

Add Plants.of_kind(kind): the sorted names of the plants of that kind. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): every plant is fed every 21 days, not 30.

Add Care.count(name): the number of waterings of the plant. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the alarm sounds below 8 °C, not 5.

Add overdue_days(care, name, day) to schedule.py: how many days day is past the next watering day, or 0 when it is not past. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): cacti are watered every 21 days, not 10.
Add Care.undo_water(name), which removes the plant's last watering; a plant with no waterings raises KeyError. Add tests.

Add Plants.set_kind(name, kind), which changes a plant's kind; the kind rule still applies. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): ferns are watered every 5 days, not 3.
Add Care.watered_on(day): the sorted names of the plants watered on day. Add tests.

Add Plants.count(): the number of plants. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): every plant is fed every 28 days, not 21.

Add Care.total_waterings(): the number of waterings over all plants. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the alarm sounds below 6 °C, not 8.
Add Plants.kinds(): the sorted list of distinct kinds in use. Add tests.
Add Care.first_watered(name): the first watering day, or None. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
